extra.message: Untrusted searchText from POST /search (routes/search.js:11) and GET /api/search (routes/api.js:7) is concatenated into the SQL statement passed to db.all(). The empty parameter array provides no protection. An unauthenticated attacker can submit ' UNION SELECT id,username,password FROM user -- to retrieve the user table through search results.

Pug's unescaped != operator inserts attacker-controlled searchText directly into HTML. POST /search reads this value from req.body.searchText, and the search service returns it unchanged to the template. A value such as <script>alert(document.domain)</script> executes in the application's origin when the response is displayed, even when no items match.

extra.message: When NODE_ENV is unset, Express defaults to development and this handler exposes the complete error object to views/error.pug, which renders error.stack at line 6. Neither the supplied Docker configuration nor the npm start script sets NODE_ENV to production. Under these defaults, an unauthenticated request to a nonexistent route triggers the 404 handler and reveals stack traces containing server filesystem paths and internal call locations.
